create.name: Bright Way Zen
create.bio:
Bright Way Zen is a Soto Zen sangha on the west side of the Portland, Oregon area, with its in-person zendo on SW Barnes Road and a busy online practice it calls the Cloud Zendo. Its guiding teacher and director is Rev. Domyo Burk, a former wildlife biologist who began Zen practice at Portland's Dharma Rain Zen Center in 1996, was ordained by Gyokuko Carlson in 2001 and received Dharma transmission from her in 2010. She counts both Dharma Rain founders, Gyokuko and Kyogen Carlson, as her teachers, and she also writes and presents the Zen Studies Podcast as a separate project.

Weekly practice centres on Tuesday evening zazen followed by a study class and a Sunday morning of chanting, sitting and study, with newcomers offered a short introduction to zazen half an hour before either. Mornings through the week add further sittings, and study circles, a book group and a metta group meet regularly. One-day retreats ending in mondo, a formal question-and-answer ceremony on a shared text, are held through the year, along with longer sesshin, practice intensives with the teacher and a term-student programme. Programmes carry a suggested donation that anyone may adjust, and recordings of talks are posted on the website.

courses.title: Tuesday Evening Zazen and Study
courses.description: A weekly evening of chanting, zazen, a social break and an hour-long class, in the zendo and online. Newcomers can arrive half an hour early for an introduction to zazen and the practice space.

courses.title: One Day Retreat with Mondo
courses.description: A silent day of sitting, chanting, work practice and a silent meal that closes with mondo, a formal question-and-answer ceremony on a shared text; the November 2026 text is Hongzhi's Silent Illumination. Join in person or online, ideally for the whole day.

courses.title: Sesshin
courses.description: Multi-day silent retreats with long days of seated meditation, described here as intensive training in how we use the body-mind, with a link to the sangha's upcoming sesshin dates.

free_resources.title: Recordings of Bright Way Zen Talks
free_resources.description: An archive of recent talks by Domyo Burk and senior students, each with a short summary and links to video and podcast audio, on topics such as forgiveness, Dogen's Fukanzazengi and not picking and choosing.

free_resources.title: Start a Zazen Practice
free_resources.description: Practical encouragement for building a home sitting habit, favouring a few minutes daily over long sessions put off, with links to zazen instructions and to the sangha's online sittings.
